compose_two_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to chain their transformations
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a weighted graph using gtn.forward_score for log-sum-exp scoring
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path for best alignment decoding
concatenate_graphs: concatenate multiple graphs in sequence using gtn.concat to chain their languages together
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a graph using gtn.remove to eliminate silent arcs
